_comment: Example watchlist for poller.sh / pr-watch-poller.sh. Copy to $HOME/.config/run-issues/watchlist.json and replace every <placeholder>. Lookup order: RUN_ISSUES_WATCHLIST if set (and then it is the ONLY candidate — a missing file is an error, never a fallback), else $HOME/.config/run-issues/watchlist.json, else the legacy $HOME/dotfiles/machine-studio/run-issues-watchlist.json. JSON has no comment syntax — the _comment key is the convention used instead.
